$comment: Rerusted design tokens: the single source of truth for the palette, control geometry, radii, spacing and type scale. Structure taken from Exponential's packages/design-tokens/tokens.json; the neutral ramp is replaced by the rusted one (hue around 35, low chroma) and the rust accent is added (#RUST-5, approved in #RUST-15). Colours are authored in OKLCH only. `cargo run --manifest-path design/tools/Cargo.toml` writes design/generated/ (sRGB hex, contrast report, swatch sheet) and design/logo/; never transcribe a colour by hand. Dark only for now; a light theme is derived later from the same hue.

palette.$comment: Values from the #RUST-5 token table. popover, sidebar = card; secondary, sidebarAccent = muted; sidebarBorder = border; every *Foreground = foreground, as in Exponential. `accent` is the rust colour (in Exponential it was a hover surface; that role is `muted` here). primary, input, ring and destructive are the #RUST-15 plan values. The accent reaches 3:1 on background, not 4.5:1: it is for fills, icons and large text, never body text.

radius.$comment: Taken unchanged from Exponential. xl2/xl3 because 2xl/3xl are not valid identifiers in every target.

size.$comment: Control geometry in px, taken unchanged from Exponential.

spacing.$comment: The one spacing scale in px, taken unchanged from Exponential.

type.$comment: Type, taken unchanged from Exponential: family, base size, size/lineHeight pairs in px, weights, and the text opacity ladder over foreground.

contrast.$comment: WCAG 2.x checks run by the generator; it fails when a pair is below its minimum. 4.5 = AA text, 3.0 = AA for UI components and large text.
